text:
Alex P: Hey folks — quick question: I keep seeing two "Orientation — Week 1" invites on my calendar (one from 'People Ops' and one from 'Onboarding Bot'). Also it's showing the start time as 16:00 GMT but I'm in PDT. Is there a canonical link/recording I should use?
Jordan (People Ops): Sorry for the confusion! We had to replace the original invite after updating the agenda. Canonical Zoom link is https://zoom.us/j/123456789?pwd=xyz — please use that one. Recording will be uploaded to Drive (Drive link below). I've also re-sent a single invite from People Ops, you should get it in a minute :wave:
onboarding-bot: Automations: Updated calendar event "Redwood Orientation (Week 1)" sent to attendees. ICS export: https://redwood-internal.example/ics/orientation-week1.ics
Samira: Thanks! Can you post the session time in a few major timezones? I couldn't tell which invite used DST.
Jordan (People Ops): Of course — session start: 2026-03-24 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CET / 01:00 SGT (next day). Note: Google Calendar should auto-convert but if it doesn't, check Settings > Time zone.
Maya T: I still don't see the new invite — did you send to my @redwood email? I'm remote in NZ (UTC+13)
Jordan (People Ops): Sent to maya@redwood.ai just now. If it's not in your inbox, try these steps: 1) open the ICS link above and click "Add to calendar" 2) in Google Calendar web: Settings → Time zone → ensure 'Ask to update time zone' is off 3) Accept the invite from the People Ops calendar (if you have multiple accounts, accept from the one you use for Redwood). If you still can't, DM me and I'll add you manually.
Alex P: Great, thanks. Where will the recording live? I might need to rewatch the security section.
Jordan (People Ops): Recording URL (once available): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrientationRecordings — final link will be posted here and in the event description. If you need access, request with "@Jordan add-drive" and I'll grant viewer rights.
Samira: :eyes: Can we also get the slide deck? I had audio trouble.
Jordan (People Ops): Slides uploaded to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ONB/pages/Orientation+Slides. I've added permission for 'redwood-onboarding' group. If you can't access, tell me which email and I'll share.
Maya T: Got the invite after adding the ICS. Thanks! Time conversion showed 05:00 NZDT which is fine. See you all tomorrow :wave:
Alex P: Perfect. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
